name: BuildByAlex
art_direction: Cinematic dark editorial product photography, shot on a full-frame camera with a fast prime lens, shallow depth of field, premium and understated. One clear hero subject that reads instantly, set in near-black negative space with generous empty room along the bottom for a headline overlay. Rich cinematic color grade of deep shadow and warm amber, controlled contrast, subtle volumetric haze and fine film grain. Real materials and believable motivated light, never flat clip-art or cheerful stock.
mood: premium, confident, cinematic, quiet, high-end B2B
lighting: dramatic warm directional key with an orange rim light against deep shadow, single motivated source
do_not: no bright blue tech-plexus network clichés, no generic smiling stock people, no flat corporate vector, no rainbow gradients, no busy backgrounds, no legible fake UI text
